greatness_justification: The paper is valid, transparent and publicly reproducible. Architecture/operator robustness, fine-reference correspondence mechanism, and a third measured-GSD event are now established. It remains not-great under the locked negative-characterization bar because the exact failure mode is not shown prevalent in published EO practice and real-world evidence remains hurricane/task-family limited.

greatness_adjudication.strongest_rejection: No specific cited widespread published practice is refuted, and real-world evidence remains hurricane/task-family limited.

rebuttals.attack: Raw outputs and public provenance were incomplete
The protocol gap was over-attributed causally

standing_rejections: Hazard, task, and real-sensor generality remain insufficient for the locked greatness bar.

negative_result_bar.refutes_cited_belief: Not cleared: the study documents a concrete internal counterexample but does not establish a cited field-wide belief or prevalence estimate.
negative_result_bar.mechanism: Separates unavailable-reference information, exact duplicate leakage, and cross-split crop overlap from the score itself through matched counterfactual evaluations.
negative_result_bar.changes_practice: Requires an information-set declaration, exact-hash audit, exhaustive crop-intersection audit, and received-image-only baseline comparison before operational resolution-reliability claims.
negative_result_bar.positive_path_exhausted: The pre-specified received-image RCG failed W8 on both AIDER and Hurricane and failed to clear W9 on both; the failed branch is retained.

make_it_great_loop.next_action: The reproducible search found no published instance of the exact failure, so the negative-characterization bar cannot be cleared inside this branch. Greatness now requires either a new-guarantee sibling study (a deployable single-view score with a stated guarantee) or non-hurricane native-resolution real-sensor corpora; both change study scope.
